text: Ozon's shares trade on the Moscow Exchange through MKPAO "Ozon"; as of 1 March 2026 its largest shareholders were AO O23 with 34.95% of issued shares and AFK "Sistema" with 31.80%, and other shareholders held 33.25%.
short: Ozon is listed on the Moscow Exchange; big shareholders are AO O23 (34.95%) and AFK Sistema (31.80%) as of 1 March 2026.

source.name: MKPAO Ozon: Annual Report 2025 (Годовой отчёт 2025), shareholders section, via Moscow Exchange
source.quote: 31,80% АФК «Система»1 33,25% Другие акционеры3 34,95% АО «О23»2 % от количества размещенных акций4
source.note: Page 42 «Информация для акционеров и инвесторов»: AFK Sistema 31.80%, AO O23 34.95%, other shareholders 33.25%; footnote 4: the share-capital structure is given as of 1 March 2026; footnote 1 adds the 16,083,675 shares of Sistema Venture Fund controlled by AFK Sistema.
